Academic Centers

  • Home
  • Academics
  • Academic Centers
Center for Global Engagement

CGE serves as a catalyst to infuse global learning and perspectives into the academic and co-curricular experience at Cal Lutheran.

Steven Dorfman Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship

This center houses a full service co-work space in Westlake Village where startups can collaborate and seek expertise.

Sarah W. Heath Center for Equality and Justice

CEJ supports organizations with similar goals and helps students have a positive impact on the community.

Center for Nonprofit Leadership

Offering practical and affordable professional development opportunities for nonprofit leaders in Ventura County.

Autism and Communication Center

This center offers resources resources to P-20 students with autism and the people who support them.

Center for Economic Research and Forecasting

CERF provides accurate, well-documented forecasts about the economy to businesses and agencies.

The Elton and Janice Gallegly Center for Public Service and Civic Engagement

A non-partisan center for students seeking meaningful ways to serve in the government and nonprofit arenas.

Center for Economics of Social Issues

CESI promotes discussions on value-based leadership and social progress both at Cal Lutheran and in the larger community.

Center for Lifelong Learning

Non-degree educational opportunities for our community, including our new “Fifty and Better” program.

Community Counseling Services

These centers in Westlake and Oxnard provide affordable counseling services to our communities.

Center for Active Learning

Promoting active learning in science classrooms at Cal Lutheran and Oxnard College.

Center for Academic Service-Learning

CASL works with faculty to provide opportunities for students to use what they learn in class to improve their community.

Center for Performance Excellence

CPE helps our student-athletes train their bodies and minds to reach their athletic potential.

Center for Educational Excellence & Equity

Preparing educators to meet the academic and social needs of 21st century learners.

SoCal Philosophy Academy

The mission of the SoCal Philosophy Academy is to promote the practice of philosophy through pre-college philosophy instruction and public philosophy.

Parenting Lab

The Parenting Lab team is dedicated to understanding how parenting practices influence child development.

Segerhammar Center

The Segerhammar Center strives to build bridges between the faith communities, academic theorists and leaders in professional life.
